query: Turn these interview notes into a case study for Palmdale SD - they cut scheduling admin time and recovered rental revenue after moving to Facilitron.
expected_behavior: Pulls available inputs (any linked Jira ticket or Confluence brief) and treats the quantified Results metrics as the spine of the draft
Uses AskUserQuestion to secure the 3-4 headline metrics and an attributable pull-quote (speaker plus title) before drafting rather than opening with an empty Results block
Structures the draft in the Facilitron Challenge -> Solution -> Results house format with a pull-quote and metrics, and flags genuinely missing facts with > TODO: instead of inventing numbers
Before drafting, requires an explicit Drive or Confluence destination and publishes the markdown with no em dashes, returning the exact durable URL, review state, owner, and approver
For a website-bound case study, records the durable approved-source URL, target surface, Jira key, asset references, and tron:guide-item or tron:news-item handoff
Uses one unique scratch workspace, cleans it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
